document.description:
This API uses heuristics, contextual machine learning, soundex, knowledge libraries and various other algorithms to enable a "similarity key" to be generated for individual people names. Similar names will generate the same similarity key (Bob Thompson, Robert Thomson, etc.), enabling redundant/duplicate name data to be identified within single datasets, used as a basis for matching across datasets, used for advanced "fuzzy" searching, and also to prevent redundant individual data records from entering a system or database.
The API can be used programmatically, but can also be used pre-integrated into various Cloud database platforms such as AWS RDS, Snowflake, Azure SQL, Google Cloud SQL, CockroachDB, Postgres, MySQL and others, allowing entire datasets to be used for automated batch calls to the API, including automatic "match reports" to be generated for a given database table. This can be seen in action at https://connect.interzoid.com
